primary_attributes.name: Strength
primary_attributes.description: Physical attack power for allies. Higher STR increases damage dealt with weapon attacks and physical skills.

scales.notes: Mitigation is target VIT * 0.4 for allies, or flat enemy VIT for enemies.
Uses the same rule as weapon attacks after a successful hit roll.

primary_attributes.name: Dexterity
primary_attributes.description: Accuracy and combo frequency. Does not increase raw physical damage.

scales.notes: One hit roll per action; combo hits reuse the same hit result.
Separate roll per extra combo hit at weapon mastery 2+.
UI preview only; actual hit uses defender stats too.

primary_attributes.name: Vitality
primary_attributes.description: Health pool and physical damage mitigation.

scales.notes: Subtracted from incoming physical damage. Enemies use a flat VIT stat instead of this formula.

primary_attributes.name: Agility
primary_attributes.description: Turn order weight and retreat success.

scales.notes: Higher AGI appears earlier in the turn queue.
Qualifying units are added to the turn queue twice per cycle.

primary_attributes.name: Intelligence
primary_attributes.description: Spell damage multiplier and healing power.

scales.notes: spell_tier_base scales with spell mastery tier.
Used by healing spells when implemented.

primary_attributes.name: Mind
primary_attributes.description: Spell hit chance. Does not affect MP pool size.

scales.formula: target_RES subtracted from caster spell hit formula
scales.notes: Also resists mental/magic ailments (design target; not fully implemented).

primary_attributes.name: Luck
primary_attributes.description: Global fudge stat affecting evasion, combos, and retreat.

scales.formula: defender_LUK * 0.5 subtracted from physical hit chance

scales.notes: Combined with DEX for combo rolls.

non_attributes.name: Move Range
non_attributes.description: Tiles a character can move per turn. Defined per character, not scaled by primary attributes.

effective_stat_layers.description: Automatic per-level gains defined in characters.json level_growth.
Flat bonuses from equipped weapons and armor.

derived_stats.name: Attack Power
derived_stats.notes: Displayed in UI; actual damage subtracts target mitigation.

enemy_stats.description: Enemies use a simplified stat block separate from the eight primaries.

fields.description: Turn order weight; uses the same extra-turn rule as allies.
Physical hit accuracy when attacking allies. Enemies do not use DEX for evasion.
Flat physical mitigation when enemies are attacked.
Spell hit defense when enemies are targeted by spells.
Flat subtraction from fire spell damage.

enemy_stats.actions: Enemy damage and effects are defined per action in enemies.json.
